title: Reachability in an induced subgraph from a contained walk
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on a vertex set $V$, let $s \subseteq V$, and let $u, v \in s$. If there is a walk $p$ from $u$ to $v$ in $G$ every vertex of which lies in $s$, then $u$ and $v$, regarded as vertices of the induced subgraph $G[s]$, are reachable from one another in $G[s]$; that is, some walk joins them within $G[s]$.
hypotheses_covered: s is a subset of the vertices
u and v lie in s
there is a walk p from u to v in G
every vertex on p's support lies in s
